reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 5 is a pure revenue-share under which Kubient pays Customer a share of revenue actually generated, with no minimum spend, volume floor, shortfall charge or take-or-pay obligation on Customer.
Section 1 expressly disclaims exclusivity and preserves Customer's right to offer Inventory through other agents or sell to third parties, so there is no volume restriction on Customer either.

Section 4(a)'s one-year no-termination lock-in does not create take-or-pay exposure because no committed spend attaches to it; the preferred position ('no minimum commitment; fees are for usage or ordered services only') is met.

Redline is unchanged and no counterparty comment is proposed, which is the correct output for a compliant finding; the rationale appropriately flags that any later Exhibit should be re-checked for minimum spend or volume floors.
